creatures.animationStatus: static baked source pose; no runtime animation claimed

creatures.name: 石像鬼
creatures.author: yd (shared adaptation of a public-domain BlendSwap model)
creatures.credit: yd (shared adaptation of a public-domain BlendSwap model) | CC0-1.0; Stone.jpg by Daniel Andersson CC0-1.0, adapted normal/roughness maps CC0-1.0
creatures.notes: Original 3D Blend is supplied despite page category 2D Art. Suitable for a carved-stone gargoyle after material conversion.
creatures.animationStatus: static baked source pose; no runtime animation claimed

creatures.name: 牛头人
creatures.author: Clint Bellanger
creatures.credit: Minotaur by Clint Bellanger, CC BY 3.0. Converted and adapted by this project. | CC-BY-3.0
creatures.notes: 1212-triangle creature plus 736-triangle axe; model is older/low-resolution, but has correct bovine anatomy, fur texture and muscle normal. Requires visual QA before calling it realistic.
creatures.animationStatus: static baked source pose; no runtime animation claimed

creatures.name: 巨狼
creatures.author: Danimal (animation/adaptation), Micket (CC0 base model), Poss (fur textures)
creatures.credit: Wolf monsters animated by Micket, Poss and Danimal, CC BY-SA 4.0: https://opengameart.org/content/wolf-monsters-animated . Converted/adapted GLB remains CC BY-SA 4.0. | CC-BY-SA-4.0
creatures.notes: Real quadruped mesh with fur diffuse/normal maps; source geometry is still low-poly and should not be called AAA. Sprite PNGs named Wolf*.png are not 3D surface textures. ShareAlike applies to adapted asset, not automatically to unrelated game code.
creatures.animationStatus: static baked source pose; no runtime animation claimed

creatures.name: 骨骸魔像
creatures.author: Mophs (model and texture), Nubux (concept)
creatures.credit: Model & Texture by Mophs @ Open Game Art. Concept art by Nubux: https://opengameart.org/content/bone-gollem-concept-art . CC BY 3.0. Converted and adapted by this project. | CC-BY-3.0
creatures.notes: Around 4k triangles, 512x512 hand-painted texture and basic posing rig. Stylized/comical bone silhouette: optional specialist asset, not a faithful realistic skeleton substitute.
creatures.animationStatus: static baked source pose; no runtime animation claimed

creatures.name: 土元素魔像
creatures.author: piacenti
creatures.credit: Earth Elemental / Golem by piacenti, CC BY 3.0. Converted and adapted by this project. | CC-BY-3.0
creatures.notes: Two 3872-3882-triangle models and diffuse/normal textures. Actual archive contains only Blender FBX 6.1 ASCII, no Blend, despite later source comments. The converter narrowly parses numeric mesh and UV arrays into a static pose, preserving the licensed mesh/UVs/material rather than executing source or claiming animation conversion.
creatures.animationStatus: static baked source pose; no runtime animation claimed
